text:
Maya: Heads up — ACME Retail showing a ~28% drop in weekly active calls and renewal in 42 days. Thinking a short 'bridge' play + downgrade-safeguard to buy time. Putting a first-pass plan here.
Liam: thanks Maya. what's the hypothesis — adoption vs cost vs integration? :thinking_face:
Maya: adoption + a flaky integration that fails nightly. product usage concentrated in 2 workflows; those are the ones dropping.
Olivia: I can run enablement. Proposed sequence: 1) 30-min triage call with Eng 2) sandbox seat + sample prompts 3) 1:1 enablement session 4) 14-day metrics check.
Nikhil: if it's an integration bug we need an eng triage ASAP. For retention, can we offer a time-limited downgrade-with-credit instead of letting them churn?
Liam: propose "downgrade-safeguard": allow moving to Starter but keep core routes enabled via feature flags + grant 20% credit for 60 days. Gives runway to recover while protecting ARR.
Maya: perfect. draft customer message below — please iterate.
Maya: ```Hi <Customer>,
We noticed your team has lower activity and one integration error. We'd like to offer a 60-day Bridge plan: 20% credit, a sandbox seat, and a 30-min technical onboarding to help recover usage. No contract change required — if you'd still wish to change plans at the end, we'll support that. Would you be open to a 30-min call next week?
— Maya (CSM)```
Olivia: sounds good. add the data point (28% drop) and an explicit checklist for next steps.
Maya: edited template:```Hi <Customer>,
We observed a 28% drop in weekly calls and an integration failure in the nightly job. We'd like to offer a 60-day Bridge plan (20% credit + sandbox seat) and a 30-min technical onboarding with our solutions engineer. Action items: [ ] Confirm time [ ] Provide failing integration log / timestamps [ ] Accept bridge plan. No contract changes; we'll reassess after 60 days.
Best, Maya```
Liam: who signs off on credits? Finance has pre-approved up to $2k/month per account for retention credits — I'll confirm the exact approval for ACME.
reminder-bot: Meeting scheduled with ACME on Tue 15:00 UTC (created by Maya)
Maya: timeline: email today, call booked by EOD Thu, enablement within 72h of call, metrics check @14 days, renewal touch at day 30.
Nikhil: creating eng triage ticket with priority P2 — tag: acme-integration. I'll ping eng-oncall for a slot. Please include sample failing request IDs.
Olivia: I'll make a short playbook card with the pre-call checklist, sample remediation steps, and a 1-page enablement slide. Sharing link in this thread shortly.
Liam: I'll handle exec outreach if we need to escalate. Also tracking billing note to add a safeguard clause if downgrade happens.
Maya: assigning tasks: Olivia — playbook & onboarding materials (due in 8h), Nikhil — triage ticket & eng ping (due in 4h), Liam — finance approval (due in 12h). I'll send customer email once finance confirms credit.
Olivia: noted. I'll include troubleshooting curl snippet and a log checklist.
Maya: troubleshooting snippet to run and send back:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ping -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" -d '{"sample":true}'
```
Nikhil: if they send logs, ask for exact timestamp range + sample request IDs. That speeds triage.
Liam: FYI — if this becomes a downgrade we record a billing note and clause to revert credits if we detect abuse.
Maya: closing the loop here. thanks team :heart: Will update when finance confirms and when playbook link is posted.
